species.name: Whorlet

dex.text: A small snail with a swirly shell and a very large sense of home. It will not be hurried, and it will not be argued out of the rain.
dex.fact: A garden snail's shell grows with it from the day it hatches, and the snail cannot leave it, because the body is anchored inside.

species.real: A garden snail has a ribbon of thousands of tiny teeth, called a radula, which it uses to rasp its way through a salad.

species.name: Shellhaven

dex.text: Has been extended, thatched and given a chimney, and the planning officer is still pretending not to notice. Smoke curls out when it feels cosy.
dex.fact: In dry spells a snail can seal its shell mouth with a skin of dried slime, called an epiphragm, and sit tight until it rains.

species.real: Snails are slow but not idle: a garden snail can sense smells through its upper tentacles and its eyes sit at the tips of them.
